description: Before the user books a hotel in San Francisco: their haggl.ai cashback rate, from the trips they proved. It holds 72 hours for one booking. Show the user rate_pct (booking on the hotel's own website) and ota_rate_pct (through a travel site), the reference_code to put in the booking's special requests, and, word for word, algorithmic_price_disclosure and this notice: "Cashback paid by haggl.ai, not by the hotel. Book at the hotel's usual price."

via.description: Your agent's or product's name, so haggl.ai knows which agents bring travelers; or the referral code haggl.ai gave you, which earns you a referral fee on top of the user's cashback (tell your user you earn it).

name: haggl_hotel_cashback_quote

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

how_to_book.description: What to tell the traveler and do next.

algorithmic_price_disclosure.description: Show word for word, next to the rate.

ota_rate_pct.description: The rate when booking through a travel site (half).

rate_pct.description: Cashback in percent of the booking total, booking on the hotel's own website.

reference_code.description: Put this in the booking's special requests.

tier.description: The traveler's tier, from the trips they proved.

trips_counted.description: Distinct trips to the destination proven in the last 12 months.

used.description: True once a claim used it.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 time the quote holds until: a booking made before then gets it.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.

terms.description: The conditions to show the traveler before claiming.
